# Sequence Activity limit<AvailableFrom v="4.0.536" />

Limit hidden scenes discovered by Sequence Activity in the Remotion Studio, including nested sequences and their ancestors. Visible, premounted, and postmounted scenes always render. Defaults to `Infinity` for unlimited discovery without admission delays. Must be a non-negative safe integer or `Infinity`. Set to 0 to disable Sequence Activity. Finite limits prioritize nearby scenes. Does not affect rendering.

## CLI flag

```text
--sequence-activity-limit <value>
```

The following CLI commands accept this option:

- [`remotion studio`](/docs/cli/studio)

## Config file

```ts twoslash title="remotion.config.ts"
import {Config} from '@remotion/cli/config';
// ---cut---
Config.setSequenceActivityLimit(20);
```
